NCO is a lightweight Windows screen recorder with hardware encoding, instant replay, microphone and desktop audio, and customizable hotkeys.

Includes the refreshed dashboard, Brown/Dark/Light themes, and clearer text and controls.

**Install:** Download **NCO-Setup.exe** below and run it. Requires 64-bit Windows 10 (1903+) or Windows 11.

The matching source package is available as **NCO-Corresponding-Source.zip**.
